question: What recent evidence materially changes SNS subsystem beliefs or creates bounded testable refinements without displacing QST-STOR-0002?
success_criteria: Create a dated roundup with machine-readable belief shifts, actions, and awareness update.
Normalize selected primary evidence into immutable evidence events.
Propose belief and quest actions without changing monthly-owned canonical governance.
Keep the active queue unchanged and QST-STOR-0002 canonical.

checks.evidence: Evidence, belief, and quest-action records contain the required v1 fields and declared scales.
No active quest, canonical move, consolidated belief ledger, ARCI weight, dependency, or automation contract was changed.
Workflow state will be inspected after PR publication.

assumptions_changed: Power-network evaluation must include starvation and fairness metrics, not aggregate delivery alone.
Swarm persistence should treat topology, role substitution, and passive design as first-class variables.
Thermal-loss candidate evidence should carry environmental degradation margins.
limitations: The NRL demonstration is terrestrial and does not establish orbital end-to-end performance.
The LEO SBSP result is a simulation preprint and policy-dependent.
The modular robotic swarm operates at a different scale and mechanical regime from 10 mm SNS nodes.
No new combined-stressor PV flight result was identified.
Weekly authority does not update monthly-owned short spawn memory or consolidated belief state.
next_action: Continue QST-STOR-0002 by producing the thermal-loss material/interface evidence checklist with environmental margins; monthly governance may later accept the SIM refinements.
